en.headline: AIA Hong Kong suspends staff member after Kwun Tong mall fight
en.dek: The insurer said a related person has been temporarily suspended after a filmed dispute at apm in Kwun Tong in which three women were arrested.
body: AIA Hong Kong said on Thursday that a related person had been temporarily suspended and that the company would follow up after a widely circulated video of a fight at the apm shopping mall in Kwun Tong.

In a statement to local media, the insurer said it had strict conduct requirements for financial planners, did not condone any form of violence, and had a mechanism to handle such matters. Comments on some of the company's social media pages were switched off after members of the public posted about the case.

Police have said three women were arrested after a dispute at a play area in the mall on Wednesday, and that the case would go to court. Officers separately posted a reminder that violence does not resolve disputes and that common assault can carry a jail term of up to one year.

zh.headline: 友邦香港就觀塚apm衝突暫停相關人士職務
zh.dek: 保險公司向傳媒表示，觀塚apm玩樂區衝突有相關人士已被暫時停任，公司會跟進；較早前有三名女子被捕。
body: 友邦香港周四回覆本地傳媒，指公司對財務策劃顧問操守有嚴格要求，不認同任何形式的暴力行為，並已有機制處理相關事宜。公司表示相關人士現已被暫時停任，並會作出適當跟進。
事件源於周三觀塚apm商場玩樂區兩家人發生爭執，片段在網上流傳後引起廣泛討論。有市民到該公司社交平台留言，其後有關專頁關閉留言功能。
警方較早前表示，三名女子因事件被捕，案件將提堂。警方另在社交平台發文，指暴力不能解決問題，普通襲擊罪一經定罪最高可判監禁一年，呼籲市民遇事保持洛靜。
